# Datadog

Datadog offers monitoring, observability, and security for cloud-scale applications, unifying metrics, logs, and traces to help teams detect issues and optimize performance

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/datadog/.

## Actions

- **Create Dashboard**: Create a dashboard in datadog.
- **Create downtime**: Creates a new downtime in datadog to suppress alerts during maintenance windows or planned outages.
- **Create monitor**: Creates a new datadog monitor to track metrics, logs, or other data sources with configurable alerting thresholds and notifications.
- **Create SLO**: Create a service level objective (slo) in datadog.
- **Create Synthetic API Test**: Create a synthetic api test in datadog.
- **Create Webhook**: Create a webhook in datadog.
- **Delete Dashboard**: Delete a dashboard in datadog.
- **Get Dashboard** (read-only): Get a specific dashboard from datadog.
- **Get host tags** (read-only): Retrieves all tags associated with a specific host in datadog.
- **Get Service Dependencies** (read-only): Get service dependency mapping from datadog apm.
- **Get Synthetics Locations**: Retrieve all available public and private locations for synthetic tests in datadog.
- **Get Trace by ID** (read-only): Get detailed information about a specific trace by its id.
- **List All Tags** (read-only): List all tags from datadog.
- **List API Keys** (read-only): List api keys in datadog.
- **List APM Services** (read-only): List apm services from datadog.
- **List AWS Integration** (read-only): List aws integrations in datadog.
- **List Incidents** (read-only): List incidents from datadog.
- **List Log Indexes**: Retrieve a list of all log indexes configured in datadog.
- **List monitors** (read-only): Get all monitor details.
- **List Roles** (read-only): List roles from datadog organization.
- **List SLOs** (read-only): List service level objectives (slos) from datadog.
- **List Synthetics Tests** (read-only): List synthetics tests from datadog.
- **List Users** (read-only): List users from datadog organization.
- **List Webhooks** (read-only): List webhooks from datadog.
- **Mute Monitor**: Mute a monitor in datadog.
- **Query metrics** (read-only): Queries datadog metrics and returns time series data.
- **Search logs** (read-only): Searches datadog logs with advanced filtering capabilities.
- **Search Spans Analytics** (read-only): Search and analyze span data with aggregations in datadog.
- **Search Traces** (read-only): Search for traces in datadog apm.
- **Submit metrics**: Submits custom metrics to datadog.
- **Unmute Monitor**: Unmute a monitor in datadog.
- **Update Dashboard**: Update a dashboard in datadog.
- **Create event**: Creates a new event in datadog.
- **Delete monitor**: Deletes a datadog monitor permanently.
- **Get monitor** (read-only): Retrieves detailed information about a specific datadog monitor, including its current state, configuration, and any active downtimes.
- **Get usage summary** (read-only): Retrieves usage summary information from datadog including api calls, hosts, containers, and other billable usage metrics.
- **List dashboards** (read-only): Lists all datadog dashboards with basic information.
- **List events** (read-only): Lists events from datadog within a specified time range.
- **List hosts** (read-only): Lists all hosts in your datadog infrastructure with detailed information including metrics, tags, and status.
- **List service checks** (read-only): Lists service checks from datadog.
- **Update host tags**: Updates tags for a specific host in datadog.
- **Update monitor**: Updates an existing datadog monitor with new configuration, thresholds, or notification settings.
